source_sensitivity.limits: Source-ID sensitivity on existing development scores, not fresh inference or a new scene-independent test. Fixed cohorts selected from content/metadata after historical4k review but before original20k full427 scoring. Unknown aliases, ancestor-model/foundation pretraining exposure and training/selection uncertainty remain unmeasured. Classical bounds/observation metadata and all original427 results are retained. No quality promotion or native-pixel review is supplied by these statistics.

hue_limitations: One observation per grid cell, one WB/camera, three brightnesses/two saturations; scene-linear HSV, not perceptually uniform. Clean targets stay below white; noisy ADC can clip. Descriptive quantiles are not confidence intervals. Not training-repeat uncertainty, real-photo quality, convergence, cause or SOTA evidence.

viewed_boards.observation: All current models remove noise but suppress fine canopy suspension lines. Building/roof geometry is restored and clouds/window detail remain soft. V86/V87 look close; these two patches show no clear context-detail advantage.

Plate variation remains smoothed while the thin light fiber survives in current models. Chart edges and isolated light points survive. RawNIND looks softer/fringed in these patches; current models are close. AHD has residual variation and is not exact RGB GT.

Brown object/illustration patches are smoothed similarly by current checkpoints. The independent AHD reference has more fine variation. No distinct broad context advantage or new conspicuous color failure is visible here.

All current models smooth sky noise and retain continuous fence diamonds. Foliage and fine building wires remain soft. V86/V87/parent/V43 look close; RawNIND fence is more broken/checkered. A small bright green point persists in current fence views. Separate ISO100 is sharper/different and not GT.

The dark high-noise carrier is almost erased in both arms. The brighter weak carrier has faint vertical bands, substantially below analytic contrast. Displayed flat fields appear smooth; numerical gain/false-detail checks remain necessary.
Both new arms reduce the parent bright-magenta mottling. New arms look close with subtle residual variation. The fixed RGB8 fields do not rule out mean-color bias or smaller numerical differences.

Both arms suppress fine cyan/blue neon wave detail; broad sign and platform geometry remain. No clear context advantage is visible. The independent ISO100 AHD reference differs in aperture/exposure time/moving subjects/lighting and is not exact GT.

The four additional palette patches look close across new arms. Parent bright-pink variation is stronger. No new glaring artifact appears in these selected fields, without a general color-accuracy claim.

manual_review.reference_caveat: GFX ISO100 and independently demosaiced AHD references are qualitative/auxiliary, not exact RGB GT. Exact GT labels apply to declared synthetic/analytic targets.
manual_review.scope: Actual fixed native160 viewing only; subsequent complete numerical/predeclared decision remains required. Selected RGB8 views cannot establish broad real-photo superiority or rule out failures elsewhere.
